LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.Title: Scavenger
LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.ConstructionDebris.D: Salvaged wreck material used to craft ammunition and weapon parts. Found in ruins and wasted structures; before T3 (Automation) the component can only be looted, after T3 it is craftable at the campfire and smithy.
LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.WeaponComponent.Desc: A finished component used as ammunition feed or weapon part in advanced defensive structures. Crafted at the campfire or smithy from salvage debris after Smithing research.
Smelt salvage debris into a finished component. Requires Smithing research (Phase 3 / Automation).
LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.Campfire.Desc: Burns steel scraps to reclaim usable steel.
LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.SteelScraps.Desc: Mangled remnants of pre-collapse steel structures.
LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.BurnSteelScraps.Desc: Burn down steel scraps in the fire to reclaim usable steel.
LanguageData.Rimconemy.Scavenger.WoodRemoved: Soft early-game wood walls — replace with steel or stone as soon as possible.
